posts.title: Footprint
posts.description: We were visiting Inari mountain. There's so much you could say about how it feels to be there, so many sights you'd want to etch within yourself. But I am often reminded of this one unassuming photo I took. Seems like it could be from anywhere. There were the summer afternoon's sunshowers there was the freshness of the air and the bright clouds there was the foliage its perfume mixing with the ear
